relationships.subject: HIF-1α
relationships.evidence_quote: HIF‐1α is a transcription factor of numerous target genes, including VEGF gene

relationships.subject: bevacizumab
relationships.evidence_quote: The combination of carboplatin and paclitaxel with bevacizumab reduced tumor size and plasma vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) levels, relieving his leg pain.

relationships.subject: VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Of these cytokines, VEGF is considered to play an important role in the development of HOA.

key_findings: Lung cancer cells in a painful HOA patient were positive for VEGF and partially HIF-1α; subcutaneous vessel walls were VEGF-positive
Bevacizumab-containing chemotherapy lowered plasma VEGF (204 to 53 pg/mL) and relieved leg pain
